name: Queue
description:
# Queue

Queue keeps an ordered list of players who want the GM's attention, with the reason for each request. It replaces Roll20's raise-hand toast, which disappears after a few seconds and doesn't say what the player wants. Requests are handled first in, first out; urgent requests go to the top unless the GM turns that off.

## Getting started

1. Install the script. It creates a 🛎 macro (visible to all), a GM-only **Queue** handout and a **Help: Queue** handout.
2. The GM is asked once whether to run the queue from **Chat** or from the **Queue handout**.
3. Each player checks **In Bar** for the 🛎 macro in the Collection tab (the API can't do this for them).

Roll20's `/raisehand` and `/rh` are not connected to the queue. Players use the 🛎 macro or `!q`.

## Players

- `!queue` or `!q` whispers a menu of request types. Click one to join the queue and get your place in line.
- One request per player. A new one replaces the old and keeps your place.
- **Make urgent** / **Make normal**, **Other...** for typed requests, and **Help someone...** / **Talk with...**, which ask which character is involved and tell that character's player.
- Requests are listed under your character and token.
- **Withdraw** removes your request. **Add note** or `!q note <text>` adds a session note.

## GM

- Run the queue from chat or from the GM-only Queue handout. Both show the same control panel. Players always use chat.
- Per request: token image pings everyone, name pings only the GM and that player, **Seen** tells the player their request was seen, **Announce** posts a public spotlight card, **X** removes it quietly.
- **Clear all** empties the queue and posts a public **QUEUE CLEARED** card.
- **Log** shows recently resolved requests. **Notes** opens the session notes handout.

## Settings

Interface, who can see the queue, how much appears in chat for the GM and players, whether urgent jumps the line, a Jukebox sound for new requests, and an editable list of request categories.

## Session notes

`!q note <text>` adds a timestamped line to a GM-only **Session Notes** handout. A time zone can be set in Settings. Other scripts can read the notes with `Queue.getNotes()`.

## Turn tracker (optional)

The queue can be mirrored in the turn tracker (visible to all players). Deleting a turn dismisses a request, dragging reorders the queue and **Next Turn** announces. During combat, requests can be inserted after the asking character's turn or hidden.

## Practice mode

`!q --test` lets a GM try the queue alone with stand-in requests made from selected tokens.

## Commands

- `!q` - request menu (player) or queue (GM)
- `!q --view` - show the queue
- `!q --withdraw` - withdraw your request
- `!q --settings` - settings
- `!q note <text>` - add a session note
- `!q --iface chat|handout` - choose the GM interface
- `!q --test` - practice mode (GM)
- `!q --whoami` - troubleshooting
- `!q --help` - link to the help handout

Full documentation is in the **Help: Queue** handout.
